name: session-facts
description: Adds the exact local time and context fill to every prompt, for the model only, and shows the session's budgets (context, plan usage, prompt cache) in a row above the prompt.

planWarnAt.title: Warn on plan usage at (%)
planWarnAt.description: A plan window at or above this share turns yellow and shows when it resets. It turns red at usage-guard's wrap-up level.

cacheWarnMinutes.title: Warn before the cache goes cold (minutes)
cacheWarnMinutes.description: The prompt-cache countdown shows once this few minutes are left. 0 shows it only once the cache is cold.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a response: 60 on a one-hour cache, 5 on the five-minute one.
